meta.name: dbt-testing
meta.description: Load when task involves adding, writing, or fixing dbt unit tests. Covers unit_tests YAML format, given/expect blocks, edge-case coverage, and the difference between unit tests and schema tests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 dbt 模型编写和修复单元测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在用 dbt 开发数据转换，需要为模型添加单元测试覆盖。
copy.tagline_en: Write and fix unit tests for dbt models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you develop dbt data transformations and need to add unit test coverage for your models.

howto.what: Claude 会帮你编写、调试 dbt 单元测试，包括定义测试数据（given）和预期结果（expect），并运行测试命令。它还会根据模型 SQL 自动确定需要测试的输入和输出列。
howto.when: 当你要求“加测试”、写单元测试或修复单元测试时触发，尤其是涉及逻辑计算、边界情况等场景。

say.text: 帮我写一个订单总额的单元测试，测试正常正数输入。
say.note: Claude 会读取模型 SQL 并生成 YAML 测试。

say.text: 为每日 NPS 模型添加所有负数输入的测试。
say.note: Claude 会生成一个针对负数输入的测试用例。

say.text: 运行所有单元测试并报告失败原因。
say.note: Claude 会执行 dbt test 并分析结果。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you write and debug dbt unit tests, including setting up test data (given) and expected outputs (expect), and running the tests. It also reads model SQL to identify input and output columns.
howto.when_en: When you ask to 'add tests', write unit tests, or fix unit tests, especially for logic, computation, or edge cases.

say_en.text: Write a unit test for order total with normal positive inputs.
say_en.note: Claude reads model SQL and generates YAML test.

say_en.text: Add a test for daily NPS with all negative reviews.
say_en.note: Claude generates a test case for negative inputs.

say_en.text: Run all unit tests and report failures.
say_en.note: Claude executes dbt test and analyzes results.
